defects.summary: Clearing large audit history removed logical records but did not reclaim free pages from legacy SQLite databases.
defects.verification: tests/audit-session-store.test.ts verifies new incremental reclamation and one-time legacy compaction; Settings exposes measured live/reclaimable bytes and isolated optimization.

defects.summary: Saved storage information and its maintenance action were vertically compressed into the lower-left corner of the Settings card.
defects.verification: scripts/verify-responsive-layout.cjs enforces dedicated wide right-side and snapped full-width storage-maintenance compositions without overflow.

defects.summary: AcoustID application keys were not normalized or validated before discovery, causing large audits to repeat opaque HTTP 400 lookup failures.
defects.verification: tests/analysis-tools.test.ts verifies whitespace trimming, the 10-character application-key contract, service-backed preflight, precise invalid-key errors, and bounded POST lookup construction.

limitations: This register establishes that no known P0 or P1 defect is unresolved; it cannot prove that an undiscovered defect does not exist.
Every confirmed release-affecting defect must be added here even when it is also tracked in GitHub.
